thread:
Ava: Quick sync — launching the Benchmark webinar next Tue. Need a compact email plan: single invite, two nurture nudges, and automated routing to SDRs. Key asks: segment rules, subject-line variants, send windows (APAC friendly), and fallback for low opens. :rocket:
Noah: Love it. Can we do a cohort waterfall? i.e., engager -> trialers -> general. Prioritize engager list for first send.
Priya: Agreed. Proposed segments (draft):
- Engagers: clicked any blog/gated benchmark in last 45d
- Trialers: active trial in last 30d but no feature usage X
- General: newsletter subscribers minus engaged/trialers
(Omar and I can export lists tomorrow)
Omar: For routing: high-interest (engagers + trialers who clicked pricing) -> SDR-A queue, others -> SDR-B. Use a TTL of 48h for routing signals.
Ava: Nice. Let's embed the routing tag as `x-sdr-route: A|B` in the webhook payload from SendGrid. mel-marketingbot will validate.
mel-marketingbot: Checklist run: email template compiles, links resolve, list sizes reported. Found: broken link in footer (fix: /docs -> /docs/getting-started).
Priya: Subject test idea A/B:
A: "See real benchmarks — Join our live demo"
B: "How much faster can inference get? Live benchmark + Q&A"
Also propose a short preview text for A/B: "Live numbers, model configs, and cost breakdowns"
Noah: For timing: send 1 (engagers) Tue 10:00am PT / 6:00pm GMT, send 2 (trialers) Wed 9:00am PT, general on Thu 8:00am PT to catch APAC in afternoon.
Ava: Nurture cadence: Invite -> Reminder 3 days before -> Day-of reminder (2 hours prior). For low opens after Day-of, swap to a short case-study drip (2 emails) over next week.
Omar: Segment rule snippet for export (SQL-ish):
```
SELECT user_id FROM events
WHERE event_type IN ('click','download')
AND ref IN ('benchmark-report','benchmark-webinar')
AND occurred_at > now() - interval '45 days'
```
Priya: Tracking: add `utm_campaign=benchmark-webinar-2026` + `utm_content=variantA|variantB`. Also add `email_stage` meta: invite/reminder/dayof for routing and analytics.
Ava: Can we automate rollback to a simple broadcast if engagement < 0.8% CTR on day 1? If yes, schedule that rule in the campaign config.
Noah: Yes — set a campaign rule: if CTR < 0.8% after 24h, pause reminders and send single concise product highlight to all segments. I'll add to the playbook.
Priya: One more — personalizing the first line for trialers: include `{{top_feature_used}}` if available, otherwise fallback to "your trial". Keeps it tight.
Ava: Sweet. Action items: Omar export lists + routing tags by EOD tomorrow, Priya assemble A/B copy & preview, Noah add rollback rule to playbook, mel-marketingbot re-run checklist after fixes. I'll draft calendar invites and share the template. :calendar: 
Omar: On it. Will ping when lists uploaded.
mel-marketingbot: Checklist re-run scheduled for 2026-03-11 16:00 UTC. Will post results here. :white_check_mark:
